recommendation.reason: Agentic SWE tasks from real GitHub PRs with executable tests, 2,438 tasks across 11 repositories; Real and Solid strong and Difficult strong.
risks: No independent leaderboard; best score is author-reported.
6 TB Docker image set may be costly to host.
Task distribution skew: pandas is nearly one-third.

release.quote: To access SWE-Gym dataset, checkout our huggingface hub page [SWE-Gym](https://huggingface.co/SWE-Gym)

redistribution_questions: What license covers the SWE-Gym dataset?
Can the pre-built Docker images be redistributed?

tasks.quote: We create SWE-Gym, the first environment for training SWE agents, with **2.4K real tasks from 11 Python repos** & a Lite split of 234 instances.

verifier.full_credit: Passing the task's test verification after fixing the repository issue.
verifier.quote: SWE-Gym combines real-world Python tasks, repository context, executable environments, and test verification to train agents for solving software engineering problems.

exceptions: SWE-Gym envs contain a git shortcut similar to [SWE-bench #465](https://github.com/SWE-bench/SWE-bench/issues/465). Please apply a git clean up script before using it to prevent models reward hacking.
runtime.quote: We also have pre-built docker images for each instance under [xingyaoww/sweb.eval.x86_64](https://hub.docker.com/search?q=xingyaoww%2Fsweb.eval.x86_64.) prefix at docker hub.

readiness.next_action: Resolve the exact Hugging Face dataset path and revision.
